_about: Every public-domain Charles Hodge (1797-1878, Princeton) text the Word Hoard holds. The Systematic Theology (3 vols + index), the Ephesians commentary and What is Darwinism? are held clean from CCEL. The Romans and Corinthians commentaries, The Way of Life and four collections of essays, discourses and church history are raw Internet Archive OCR. Gutenberg has only What is Darwinism? (PG 19192), which CCEL already supplies. Not A. A. Hodge, his son, whose books are not shelved here. Extended 2026-10-28 by lane A at Adam's request (his Logos author list): Princeton Sermons (1879), England and America (1862), What is Presbyterianism? (1855), his sermons and addresses of 1822 to 1882 (his unsigned Princeton Review articles are held until Adam rules on catalogue attributions). Every printing dated before 1930.
